interface.read_write_clients: role-indexed 0..20 narrow data ports; roles 3 and 4 can request paired 256-bit reads from B2/B3/B10/B11
interface.status: bank_busy and owner plus sticky child/error summary

control_rules.acquire_release: The common ownership table stores one role per bank; dispatcher must atomically acquire all operand banks before executor data traffic and release after final data operation.
control_rules.routing: Only model-valid role-bank pairs and authorized owner requests reach XPM memory ports.
control_rules.error: Ownership or router error sets sticky subsystem_error until reset; fabric must turn this into failed command completion and prevent success.
control_rules.reset: Ownership clears, but memory data remains; tensor validity is separately reset by bank_tensor_state_tracker.

required_cases: DMA_LOAD-style write then compute read across release/reacquire
data and ownership behavior across reset
unauthorized request reports an error without writing
combined 200 MHz OOC resource and timing
simultaneous paired GEMM reads from B2 and B3
verification.proof_scope: local data ownership and storage only; no vendor DataMover transfer, numeric executor, DDR, Vitis or board execution
